(1) Yes, the large stone blocks on the left are rendered very dark, appearing as almost black silhouettes.
(2) Yes, there is a distinct light greenish-white horizontal band or line across the middle distance at the base of the back wall.
(3) The lighting appears to be **ambient** (or "fullbright"), with a strong directional light source coming from the front/above, as evidenced by the bright, flat appearance of the front-facing surfaces and the lack of deep shadows on the ground.
